prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1339; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in here in Houston. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting to turn. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper pretty hard.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How fast do you think the other vehicle was going when it hit you?

A: I'd guess it was moving at a decent speed, maybe thirty or thirty-five miles an hour. I didn't see it coming because I was looking at the light.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the collision?

A: My wrist hurt right away. I had put my hand out on the steering wheel when the impact happened, and I felt a sharp pain. I didn't think much of it at first, but it kept getting worse.

Q: Have you seen a doctor about your wrist?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care center that same day. They took X-rays and told me it was fractured. I've since been referred to an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?

A: No, I was the only one in the car.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They apologized and said they had looked down at their phone for a second. A police officer came and took a report.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car fixed and my wrist healed.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
